name: Encore Radio - Start
description: Start after-hours streaming using the configured source (Internet Radio, Network Share, TuneIn, Pandora, or Spotify).

name: Encore Radio - Stop
description: Stop after-hours streaming and release the audio output.

name: Encore Radio - Sync Spotify Service
description: Internal: enable/disable the Raspotify (Spotify Connect) service to match whether Spotify is configured. Dispatched automatically after every config save - not meant to be run manually.
